characters.notes: Soul vs Element comparison run 2026-07-01 (see assets/tests/soul-vs-element/): 3 matched scenes each. Soul V2 (text2image_soul_v2, custom_reference_id) showed clear identity drift — different hair, face shape, and features across scenes. Element approach (nano_banana_2 image-reference, CLI has no direct element_id support) held facial identity consistently across all 3 scenes — first pass used an AI-generated portrait as reference (assets/web/nafisa-library-e-soul2-v1.webp), re-run used the real photo nafisa-hero-v2.webp (assets/tests/soul-vs-element/element-v2-hero-ref/) and confirmed the same result with a clean identity source: nose ring, hair color/texture, and face held across all 3 scenes. Default to image-reference/nano_banana_2 with nafisa-hero-v2.webp as the canonical reference photo for this character; avoid Soul V2 for multi-scene consistency needs.
